fullText.simplified:
包大人

    话说这位包大人非常厉害。他为人们办事，不怕坏人，大家都很喜欢他。但是也因为他喜欢为人们办事，只看法律，不给大官们面子，所以很多大官都讨厌他。因为他的脸很黑，所以讨厌他的那些大官们都叫他“包黑子”。
    香儿母子三人被带到包大人的府里。包大人看着香儿，问道：“你是什么人？”
    “我……我是陈家村人，带着孩子们到这里来找丈夫。”香儿说话的声音很小，她还在害怕。她第一次看到有人自杀，而且还是死在自己面前，换作是谁都会害怕。
    “死的那个人叫什么名字？是你的什么人？”
    “我……不知道他叫什么名字，他是陈世美叫来杀我们的。”香儿抱着孩子们，觉得这两天真的发生了太多事情。
    “杀你们？这么说，是他想杀你们，却被你杀了？”包大人的声音不大，但是会让人害怕。
    “包大人，我没有杀他，他是自杀的呀！”香儿的声音大了很多，她害怕包大人认为七子是她杀的。突然，她想到了衣服！对，七子自杀前写了字在衣服上，让她拿给包大人看的。“这里有他写的东西，我不认识字，不知道他写的是什么。”香儿说着把那件衣服拿了出来。
    包大人拿起那件衣服，很快地看了一遍衣服上的字，吃惊地站了起来：是驸马要杀这母子三人？有这样的事？
    包大人拿起衣服，又看了一遍。他原来以为这是一个简单的杀人案，没想到关系到驸马，这可就不简单了。他小声地问身边的手下：“死的那个人是驸马府的人吗？”
    他的手下拿起七子的那把刀，看了看，说：“刀上有名字，七子。驸马身边是有一个叫七子的卫士。”
    包大人点点头，又问香儿：“那驸马为什么要杀你们呢？”
    包大人不问还好，这一问，香儿又想起了她的伤心事。她决定把她的伤心事从头说起……
fullText.traditional:
包大人

    話說這位包大人非常厲害。他為人們辦事，不怕壞人，大家都很喜歡他。但是也因為他喜歡為人們辦事，只看法律，不給大官們面子，所以很多大官都討厭他。因為他的臉很黑，所以討厭他的那些大官們都叫他“包黑子”。
    香兒母子三人被帶到包大人的府裡。包大人看著香兒，問道：“你是什麼人？”
    “我……我是陳家村人，帶著孩子們到這裡來找丈夫。”香兒說話的聲音很小，她還在害怕。她第一次看到有人自殺，而且還是死在自己面前，換作是誰都會害怕。
    “死的那個人叫什麼名字？是你的什麼人？”
    “我……不知道他叫什麼名字，他是陳世美叫來殺我們的。”香兒抱著孩子們，覺得這兩天真的發生了太多事情。
    “殺你們？這麼說，是他想殺你們，卻被你殺了？”包大人的聲音不大，但是會讓人害怕。
    “包大人，我沒有殺他，他是自殺的呀！”香兒的聲音大了很多，她害怕包大人認為七子是她殺的。突然，她想到了衣服！對，七子自殺前寫了字在衣服上，讓她拿給包大人看的。“這裡有他寫的東西，我不認識字，不知道他寫的是什麼。”香兒說著把那件衣服拿了出來。
    包大人拿起那件衣服，很快地看了一遍衣服上的字，吃驚地站了起來：是駙馬要殺這母子三人？有這樣的事？
    包大人拿起衣服，又看了一遍。他原來以為這是一個簡單的殺人案，沒想到關係到駙馬，這可就不簡單了。他小聲地問身邊的手下：“死的那個人是駙馬府的人嗎？”
    他的手下拿起七子的那把刀，看了看，說：“刀上有名字，七子。駙馬身邊是有一個叫七子的衛士。”
    包大人點點頭，又問香兒：“那駙馬為什麼要殺你們呢？”
    包大人不問還好，這一問，香兒又想起了她的傷心事。她決定把她的傷心事從頭說起……

sentences.traditional: “我……我是陳家村人，帶著孩子們到這裡來找丈夫。”

sentences.english: “I … I’m from the Chen family village. I brought my children here to look for my husband.”

sentences.simplified: 香儿说话的声音很小，她还在害怕。

sentences.english: It was the first time she had seen a suicide, and he died right in front of her. Anyone would be scared in her place.

sentences.english: “What is the name of the deceased? What is your relation with him?”

sentences.simplified: “我……不知道他叫什么名字，他是陈世美叫来杀我们的。”

sentences.english: “Kill you? So you’re saying that it was he who wanted to kill you, but you killed him?”

sentences.pinyin: bāo dà rén de shēng yīn bú dà dàn shì huì ràng rén hài pà
sentences.english: Lord Bao’s voice wasn’t loud, but it could scare people.

sentences.pinyin: bāo dà rén wǒ méi yǒu shā tā tā shì zì shā de ya xiāng er de shēng yīn dà le hěn duō
sentences.english: “Lord Bao, I didn’t kill him; he killed himself!” Xiang’er’s voice grew much louder.

sentences.traditional: 對，七子自殺前寫了字在衣服上，讓她拿給包大人看的。

sentences.english: Yes, Qizi wrote on his clothes before he killed himself, so she would show it to Lord Bao.

sentences.english: “Here’s what he wrote. I can’t read, so I don’t know what he wrote,” Xiang’er said, and took out the item of clothing.

sentences.english: Lord Bao picked up the item of clothing, and quickly read what was written on it. Shocked, he stood up.

sentences.simplified: 是驸马要杀这母子三人？有这样的事？
sentences.traditional: 是駙馬要殺這母子三人？有這樣的事？

sentences.pinyin: bāo dà rén ná qǐ yī fu yòu kàn le yí biàn
sentences.english: Lord Bao picked up the item of clothing, and read it again.

sentences.english: He didn’t expect that it would involve the emperor’s son-in-law. This really wasn’t simple!

sentence_translations: Lord Bao
It is said that Lord Bao was very formidable. He worked for the people and was not afraid of bad people.
Everyone liked him. But also because he liked to work for the people, and only considered the law, ..
.. not giving face to high officials, many of those high officials loathed him.
Because he had a very dark complexion, the high officials that loathed him called him “Bao Heizi”.
Xiang’er and her children were brought into Lord Bao’s official residence.
Lord Bao looked at Xiang’er, and asked, “Who are you?”
“I … I’m from the Chen family village. I brought my children here to look for my husband.”
Xiang’er spoke very quietly. She was still scared.
It was the first time she had seen a suicide, and he died right in front of her. Anyone would be scared in her place.
“What is the name of the deceased? What is your relation with him?”
“I … don’t know his name. He was sent here by Chen Shimei to kill us.”
Xiang’er held her children, thinking that these couple of days really had been too eventful.
“Kill you? So you’re saying that it was he who wanted to kill you, but you killed him?”
Lord Bao’s voice wasn’t loud, but it could scare people.
“Lord Bao, I didn’t kill him; he killed himself!” Xiang’er’s voice grew much louder.
She was afraid that Lord Bao believed Qizi was killed by her. Suddenly, she thought of the clothes!
Yes, Qizi wrote on his clothes before he killed himself, so she would show it to Lord Bao.
“Here’s what he wrote. I can’t read, so I don’t know what he wrote,” Xiang’er said, and took out the item of clothing.
Lord Bao picked up the item of clothing, and quickly read what was written on it. Shocked, he stood up.
It was the emperor’s son-in-law that wanted to kill this mother and her children? Was it like this?
Lord Bao picked up the item of clothing, and read it again.
Before, he had been under the impression that this was a simple murder case.
He didn’t expect that it would involve the emperor’s son-in-law. This really wasn’t simple!
He quietly asked a subordinate next to him, “Is the deceased from the emperor’s son-in-law’s official residence?”
His subordinate picked up Qizi’s sword, examined it, and said, ..
.. “The name Qizi is on the sword. There is a guard called Qizi working beside the emperor’s son-in-law.”
Lord Bao nodded, and asked Xiang’er again, “So why would the emperor’s son-in-law want to kill you?”
It would have been better if Lord Bao hadn’t asked. This question reminded Xiang’er of her heartbreaking story again.
She decided to start telling her heartbreaking story from the beginning …
